n237c512a84.headline: Poundland to sell chilled and frozen food in 60 UK stores
n237c512a84.summary: Value retailer Poundland will begin selling chilled and frozen food in 60 UK stores, with shops in Gateshead, Hartlepool, Sunderland and Nottingham among the first.
n237c512a84.why: Poundland is a UK discount retailer, and range expansion into food is a way to win shopper spending.

nefcf97cdde.headline: Portugal Will Start Enforcing OECD Global Tax Treaty June 1 - Law360 Tax Authority
nefcf97cdde.summary: Portugal has enacted the OECD's chief tool against cross-border corporate tax avoidance. Enforcement starts June 1, the OECD said Monday.
nefcf97cdde.why: The OECD framework targets cross-border tax avoidance by multinationals, which affects corporate tax bases and planning for global companies.

n01a4270182.headline: Netanyahu renews vows to annex Palestinian territories
n01a4270182.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pledged on Sunday to annex key parts of the occupied West Bank within a set timeframe. The article gives no further detail on the timing.
n01a4270182.why: Territorial annexation raises political and security risks for Israel and can affect investor sentiment toward Israeli assets and regional stability.

nc91523eb5f.headline: PM reveals plan for ‘hard bargain’ in push for US trade deal
nc91523eb5f.summary: Ministers are due to publish the Government's negotiating mandate for a US trade deal on Monday. The prime minister has signalled a tough approach to the talks.
nc91523eb5f.why: Trade agreements between the UK and the US affect tariffs, market access and sector outlooks for British and American exporters and investors.

n17839e9892.headline: Today in the press
n17839e9892.summary: A gambling business eyeing a €12 billion merger with Irish betting giant Flutter Entertainment is cutting jobs at a Dublin office.
n17839e9892.why: Flutter Entertainment is a major online betting operator, and large merger talks can reshape the sector's competitive landscape.

n70df450e2c.headline: Why the Teck Resources's (TECK.B) Stock Price Fell 21.1% in February
n70df450e2c.summary: Teck Resources stock tumbled after the withdrawal of the Frontier oil sands project, delays in its copper project and coronavirus fears. The shares fell 21.1% in February.
n70df450e2c.why: Teck is a Vancouver-based diversified miner with copper and steelmaking coal assets, so project setbacks and commodity demand concerns directly affect its shares.

nd94edf6ee0.headline: More traffic, night lights show China's factories restart as Covid-19 takes a break
nd94edf6ee0.summary: Nearly 300 million people have returned to work in China since the Lunar New Year break, as companies restart and coronavirus travel curbs ease. Many small firms still struggle to recruit enough workers.
nd94edf6ee0.why: China is a central node of global manufacturing and supply chains, so the pace of factory restarts affects global trade, commodity demand and corporate earnings.

n6c709a0b58.headline: Brazil's cracked city leaves corporate heavyweights on the hook
n6c709a0b58.summary: A sudden, violent tremor knocked a resident to his kitchen floor in Maceio, a Brazilian city with little seismic history. Reuters reports that corporate heavyweights face liability for the damage.
n6c709a0b58.why: Maceio's ground damage has been linked to salt mining by Braskem, a major petrochemical producer, so liability claims affect the company's finances. Investors track such contingent liabilities closely.

na3db95a6ce.headline: Global growth plunging into downturn over coronavirus, OECD says
na3db95a6ce.summary: The OECD warned on Monday that the coronavirus outbreak is plunging the world economy into its worst downturn since the global financial crisis. The warning came from its Paris headquarters.
na3db95a6ce.why: The OECD is the Paris-based intergovernmental body that publishes global economic forecasts used by governments, central banks and investors.
na3db95a6ce.why_moved: The OECD's outlook of the worst global downturn since the financial crisis, attributed to the coronavirus outbreak, points to a sharp expected slowdown in growth.

n119adbd0f2.headline: Exchange Rates Daily Today 02.03.2020: Pound Reacts To UK Coronavirus Cases, Euro Jumps, Dollar Soft As Commodities Rebound
n119adbd0f2.summary: The British pound weakened following UK coronavirus cases, while the euro strengthened and the Canadian dollar led gains among majors due to a rebound in oil prices.
n119adbd0f2.why: Currency movements reflect market reactions to coronavirus developments and commodity price changes, affecting trade and investment flows.
n119adbd0f2.why_moved: Coronavirus developments in the UK and rising oil prices influenced currency markets, weakening the pound and boosting the euro and Canadian dollar.

na1cd34abd7.headline: Profit From Buying Canada’s Most International Bank on the Dip
na1cd34abd7.summary: Investors are advised to buy Bank of Nova Scotia shares, which are attractively valued despite a weak near-term outlook.
na1cd34abd7.why: Bank stocks reflect financial sector health and can be influenced by economic conditions and monetary policy.

nab3ca86b8b.headline: Stocks partially reverse last week
nab3ca86b8b.summary: Major US indices rebound after losses, as markets respond to COVID-19 developments and government measures.
nab3ca86b8b.why: Market movements reflect investor sentiment about the economic impact of the coronavirus pandemic.

n2fe5e16bbb.headline: Commodity prices, debt skyrocket over 100% since 2015
n2fe5e16bbb.summary: Since 2015, Zambia's major commodity prices and external public debt have more than doubled, with fuel and mealie meal prices rising significantly.
n2fe5e16bbb.why: Rising commodity prices and debt levels affect Zambia's fiscal stability and currency outlook, impacting investor sentiment.

n0abff8c726.headline: Oscars: Big lesson from South Korea’s Parasite
n0abff8c726.summary: The South Korean film ‘Parasite’ won top awards at the Oscars, highlighting South Korea’s growing cultural influence and export potential.
n0abff8c726.why: Cultural exports can boost related sectors like entertainment, tourism, and consumer goods in South Korea.

n552cca3252.headline: Dow surges on hopes for central bank help to brunt coronavirus impact
n552cca3252.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose sharply amid expectations of central bank measures to mitigate COVID-19 economic impact.
n552cca3252.why: Market rally reflects investor optimism about monetary policy support and economic stabilization efforts.
n552cca3252.why_moved: Expectations of monetary easing and liquidity injections boost investor confidence and market valuations.

n25ff1259ba.headline: Baht climbs out of nine-month low against US dollar
n25ff1259ba.summary: The Thai baht strengthened from a nine-month low, trading around Bt31.33 per US dollar.
n25ff1259ba.why: Currency movements reflect economic sentiment and can influence trade competitiveness and capital flows in Thailand.

n9107ff1167.headline: Indonesia steps up intervention, unveils stimulus to curb market outflows
n9107ff1167.summary: Indonesia announces stimulus measures to stabilize markets and prevent capital outflows during the economic impact of COVID-19.
n9107ff1167.why: Market intervention can influence investor confidence and currency stability in Indonesia.

na55a8d64bf.headline: NZ Internal Affairs shifts RealMe citizen digital identity services to Azure
na55a8d64bf.summary: New Zealand's government transitions its digital identity services to a cloud-based platform to improve security and scalability.
na55a8d64bf.why: Digital identity infrastructure supports secure online services, impacting government efficiency and digital economy growth.

n59edb5a6de.headline: China's Manufacturing Nosedives As Anti-Virus Controls Hit Economy
n59edb5a6de.summary: Factory activity in China declined at its fastest rate and lowest level on record due to anti-disease controls disrupting supply chains.
n59edb5a6de.why: China's manufacturing sector is a key component of global supply chains; downturn affects global trade and commodity demand.
n59edb5a6de.why_moved: Record low factory activity signals economic slowdown, impacting global supply chains and markets.

nfe277696cb.headline: 'Coronavirus outbreak plunging economy into worst downturn'
nfe277696cb.summary: The OECD warns the coronavirus outbreak is causing the worst global economic downturn since the financial crisis, urging governments and central banks to respond.
nfe277696cb.why: This highlights the significant economic impact of COVID-19, influencing investor sentiment and policy responses worldwide.
nfe277696cb.why_moved: Global economic outlook deteriorates due to COVID-19, affecting markets and investor confidence.

na701617c9e.headline: Tilray Posts Huge Revenue Growth -- and a Huge Loss -- in Q4
na701617c9e.summary: Cannabis company Tilray posted high revenue growth in Q4, but continued to incur substantial losses compared to the previous year.
na701617c9e.why: Financial results highlight the volatility and investment risks in the rapidly growing cannabis industry.

na0c6596f33.headline: A trade deal with America will not compensate Britain for the loss of EU benefits
na0c6596f33.summary: The UK government estimates a free trade agreement with the US could add $4.3 billion to the economy over 15 years, highlighting limited gains from the deal.
na0c6596f33.why: Trade agreements influence national economic growth, trade flows, and investor sentiment regarding UK-US relations.

n8fd4c323e9.headline: Post-Brexit US trade deal: 0.16% economic boost predicted
n8fd4c323e9.summary: The UK government projects a 0.16% economic boost from a future trade agreement with the US amid ongoing negotiations.
n8fd4c323e9.why: Trade agreements with the US can influence the UK economy by affecting exports, tariffs, and market access post-Brexit.

nfed4efb5a6.headline: Malawi Legalizes Medical Marijuana
nfed4efb5a6.summary: Malawi's legalization of medical cannabis aligns with regional trends, potentially creating new economic opportunities.
nfed4efb5a6.why: Legalization can lead to growth in agricultural exports and medicinal cannabis markets.

n7a7ec72757.headline: Indonesia adds to US$6 bil spending to stem currency, bond rout
n7a7ec72757.summary: Indonesia has increased spending to stem a currency and bond rout, as the rupiah slumped 4.6%, making it Asia’s worst-performing currency last month.
n7a7ec72757.why: The Indonesian government aims to support its currency and bond markets, which are vital for investor confidence and economic stability.
n7a7ec72757.why_moved: Government intervention to support the rupiah and bond markets amid currency depreciation.

ncb836cb873.headline: Stocks up sharply on Wall Street following 7-day rout
ncb836cb873.summary: US equities rose sharply, recovering some losses from a seven-day decline driven by concerns over the coronavirus impact on the global economy.
ncb836cb873.why: Stock market movements reflect investor sentiment and expectations about economic growth amid health crises.
ncb836cb873.why_moved: Market rebound indicates changing investor outlook on economic resilience amid health concerns.

nb8fec18ca5.headline: Impasse Stalls Tax Reform in Congress
nb8fec18ca5.summary: Members of the joint committee, which begins work tomorrow, will have difficulty reaching consensus on simplifying taxes inside and outside Parliament.
nb8fec18ca5.why: Tax reform changes how businesses and consumers are taxed, which affects corporate profitability and investment planning in Brazil.

nf65d7a5d81.headline: Shanghai Rebounds More Than 3% at Close After a Week of Losses
nf65d7a5d81.summary: Chinese stock markets closed sharply higher on Monday, March 2, after last week's plunge alongside world markets. The Shanghai market rose more than 3% at the close.
nf65d7a5d81.why: The Shanghai Composite tracks stocks listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange and is a key gauge of Chinese equity sentiment.
nf65d7a5d81.why_moved: Chinese markets rebounded after a sharp prior-week plunge that had accompanied a global sell-off.

n298f603a9a.headline: Market Economists Lower Inflation and GDP Forecasts for 2020 and See a Higher Dollar
n298f603a9a.summary: Brazilian market economists lowered their 2020 GDP growth forecast from 2.20% to 2.17% and trimmed inflation expectations slightly. They also expect a higher dollar.
n298f603a9a.why: Surveys of market economists track consensus expectations for growth and inflation, which guide interest-rate and currency pricing. A stronger dollar generally weakens emerging-market currencies such as the Brazilian real.
